title: Paint & Play with Mrs. Claus
seo_title: Paint & Play with Mrs. Claus at Fun Mountain
description: Paint & Play with Mrs. Claus is a holiday painting workshop for kids, where young artists create a holiday-themed painting with step-by-step guidance from Mrs. Claus and enjoy a snack. It takes place Monday, November 30, 2026, from 1:00 to 3:00 PM in the Table Rock Event Room at Fun Mountain.
venue: Table Rock Event Room at Fun Mountain
